expected_rule: Do not use primary/secondary endpoint hierarchy.
Test treatment, exposure, and treatment x exposure for model-tested endpoints.
Analyze battery context separately from ethanol pharmacology.
Run one single full-battery BT1 PCA.
Assign labels from loadings after PCA is run.
Treat Kc/Kf/condition factor as the same construct if formula/range audit passes.
Use PC scores and centroids as descriptive annotations, not primary inference.
Begin with concordance audit, then robustness and stability checks.
